plan.module_pool: All uniquely resolved allowed-set main-card printings from the pinned catalogue; sourceIr/dataOnly complete runtime admission; no flagged construction text; canonical and name/subtitle aliases grouped.
plan.keywords: Recorded as exact/changed separately; never assumed equal or used for lexicographic selection.
plan.module_selection: For source10,14,25 in order, lexicographic A/near/far code tuple with IR(A,near)<IR(A,far)-1e-12; all module names absent background; all9 module identities disjoint. Lexicographically first feasible joint assignment, no vectors/review judgments used.
plan.anchor: Synthetic: remove first3 expanded copies in sorted raw-code order; add3A. Background leader/base/size retained. New profile may differ from authored original.
plan.variants: Replace1 or2 A copies by near/far card, exact full-deck cost/type/arena/aspects/power/HP profile versus synthetic anchor and equal count overlap;3anchors+12variants+6permutation/split invariances=21rows.
plan.first_phase: Publish all strict groups, eligibility reasons, distances and disjoint-module feasibility before deck generation.
plan.interpretation: New conditional IR-structural proxy assay, not a relaxed v1 primary test, behavioral truth, coherence or strength. V1 failures remain unchanged.

ir_proxy.path_matching: exact typed all-side ordered JSON path, containers retained; object keys sorted; root ability display title excluded
ir_proxy.numeric: abs(x-y)/max(1,abs(x),abs(y)); unmatched path/type is1; categorical mismatch is1; each group mean then equal group mean
ir_proxy.semantics: Structural proxy only, no execution or strategic meaning; no textual similarity or learned parameters
